command: import ast,pathlib; root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); files=sorted(p for folder in ('src','tests','scripts') for p in (root/folder).rglob('*.py')); [ast.parse(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'),filename=str(p)) for p in files]; print(f'Parsed {len(files)} current Python files; no application or provider execution.')
